messages:
Rin: Small UX nit from QA: action kebab in the compact rules table is visually fine but users keep missing the tap area on mobile. The icon is 16px and the cell got squished. Screenshot: https://figma.redwood/compact-kebab-miss.png
Leo: Got it. We tightened padding to hit density goals and accidentally reduced hitboxes. We currently rely on implicit cell padding for targets.
Cass: Quick idea: keep a 40x40 hit area via CSS `::after` invisible hit mask instead of layout changes. Avoids column width shifts.
Tara: I like the mask for layout stability but worried about clipping in sticky columns. If overflow:hidden is present, mask can get cut off.
A11yBot: Reminder: WCAG/actionable size recommendation is 44x44 CSS px for touch. If you must go smaller visually, ensure alternative ways to activate (keyboard, long-press menu) and announce with aria-describedby.
DesignKitBot: From component library perspective, we introduced `--action-hit` variable last cycle but not documented. Suggest we standardize as `--rdw-action-hit` and set fallback to 44px.
Rin: Also, we have to decide where feedback shows. Right now the row shows a spinner then a global toast. In modals the toast goes under modal (z-index bug). Users are losing confirmations.
Leo: Two options: 1) make toasts float above modals (raise z-index) 2) provide inline ephemeral cues anchored to the row (preferred for dense tables).
Cass: Inline cue wins for discoverability in tables. Implementation: `Toast.inline(targetCell)` that renders absolutely positioned within the table stacking context. No global z-index needed.
Tara: Inline toast must not steal focus. Use `role="status" aria-live="polite"` and ensure it times out. Also it should collapse without causing layout shift. Use transform + opacity.
A11yBot: Also ensure screenreader users get an announcement when action starts (not just when it completes). `aria-live` at start with short message like "Retry started" helps. Don't move focus.
DesignKitBot: For tokens, we can expose `--rdw-action-hit` and `--rdw-inline-toast-gap`. But let's avoid token sprawl: use `--rdw-action-hit` and `spacing.xs` for gap.
Rin: Decision: prototype invisible hit mask for canary but add standalone action column variant in the component for long-term. Add `Toast.inline` for row feedback and keep global toasts for cross-route ops.
Leo: I'll open a PR with demo page + mobile screenshots. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/2472
Cass: QA checklist: 1) touch target >= 40px, 2) inline toast visible when modal open, 3) no layout shift, 4) screenreader announces start and end.
Tara: I'll update Figma with hit mask layer and include reduced-motion frames.
Rin: Thanks all 44D. Ship behind flag on canary for 7 days and gather metrics on missed taps.
